title: EXP-111 - Hello World Part 7 Section 8: Sign-In Page Contents in FlexLayoutMain's signinpage Region of FX_CustomerPortal (StaticSignIn, StaticImage1, StaticCustID2, EditCustID, ButtonSignIn2) with a Save After Each Step and a Console-Error Stop, Then Close/Reopen Readback
objective: Build Hello World Part 7 Section 8 (12:08-15:24): five components stacked in FlexLayoutMain > Region02: signinpage of FX_CustomerPortal (User scope). T1 is a read-only gate: the signinpage region is empty, the menu Buttons and other regions are unchanged, and the strings FX_sSignIn (Sign In) and FX_sCustomerID (Part 5) are read. T2 adds StaticSignIn (Caption FX_sSignIn, Theme Class FX_Header, Justification Center, No Colon True, Size 20; 1.5, Margin 0,1,0,1) and StaticImage1 (Bitmap File Name FX_CustomerSignIn.png, No Colon True, Size 21; 8, Margin 0,1,0,1). T3 adds StaticCustID2 (Caption FX_sCustomerID, Justification Center, No Colon True, Size 20; 1.5) and EditCustID (Justification Center, Size 20; 1.5; Binding Type left unchanged: the Variable Customer ID binding is deferred to Part 8 with StaticCustID). T4 adds ButtonSignIn2 (Caption FX_sSignIn, Theme Class FX_BlueButton, Size 20; 1.5, Margin 0,1,0,1; no event). Every step gets one Designer Save and the run stops before any further server event if the page console error count rises. T5 verifies all five components after an ordinary close and reopen and writes the final audit. Findings are observed only.
